PR title: fix(formulas): append work-bead notes instead of replacing them

PR description:
## Problem

Five core-pack formula steps pass `--notes` to `$WORK_BEAD_ID`. `bd update --notes` replaces the notes field, so each of these steps discards any notes the bead already carries. On 2026-09-15 one such write destroyed four coordinator notes on a live issue; the operator recovered them from `dolt_history_issues`, which worked only because someone noticed in time.

beads PR https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/pull/6583 makes `bd update --notes` refuse the write when the target bead already holds different, non-empty notes. Once that lands, these five steps fail instead of clobbering. This change moves them to `--append-notes`, which preserves the history and already works with the current `bd`.

## Change

`--notes` becomes `--append-notes` at the five sites that target `$WORK_BEAD_ID`:

- `internal/bootstrap/packs/core/formulas/mol-do-work.toml` (the shipped close and the no-op close)
- `internal/bootstrap/packs/core/formulas/mol-polecat-commit.toml`
- `internal/bootstrap/packs/core/formulas/mol-polecat-report.toml`
- `internal/bootstrap/packs/core/formulas/mol-prompt-synth.toml`

`mol-do-work.toml` keeps `--notes` for `$GC_BEAD_ID` and `$DRAIN_BEAD_ID`, because a step wisp and a drain bead hold no prior notes.

`TestCoreMolPolecatReportWriteReportStepRecordsNoteAndAvoidsPRFlow` pinned the literal substring `--notes`, which `--append-notes` does not contain, so the expected substring moves with the flag. The assertion's intent is unchanged: the step records the report on the work bead.

`internal/bdflags/bdflags.go` already lists `--append-notes` as a value flag for `bd update`, so `gc bd` forwards it today with no other change.

## Verification

    export CGO_CFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/icu4c/include"
    export CGO_CXXFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/icu4c/include"
    export CGO_LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/icu4c/lib"

    $ go build ./internal/bootstrap/...
    $ go test -count=1 ./internal/bootstrap/...
    ok  github.com/gastownhall/gascity/internal/bootstrap            0.958s
    ok  github.com/gastownhall/gascity/internal/bootstrap/packs/core 2.127s

The CGO variables point at the Homebrew ICU headers; without them the `dolthub/go-icu-regex` dependency fails on `unicode/regex.h` on this workstation, on unmodified `main` too.

---

## Maintainer additions (v1.5.0 release blocker)

This change is being taken for v1.5.0 as a data-loss fix. It is long-standing (the same lines ship in v1.4.2), not a regression. Thanks @graham-a11y for the original fix; the commits below are pushed onto this branch.

**Root cause:** `bd update --notes` replaces the notes field (beads `cmd/bd/update.go`, `updates["notes"] = notes`). Five core-formula sites wrote it to `$WORK_BEAD_ID`: `mol-do-work.toml:121,130`, `mol-polecat-commit.toml:161`, `mol-polecat-report.toml:166`, `mol-prompt-synth.toml:146`. Scripted agents did the same through `cmd/gc/cmd_agent_script.go:392` (`bd_update notes:` emitted `--notes`).

**Added on top of the original commit:**
- `cmd/gc/polecat_report_formula_test.go:53,71` still required the literal `bd update "$WORK_BEAD_ID" --notes`, so the original commit broke `TestPolecatReportFormulaParsesAndHasNoGHPRCreate`. It now expects `--append-notes`.
- New guard `TestCoreFormulasNeverReplaceWorkBeadNotes` (`internal/bootstrap/core_formula_report_test.go`). It scans every `packs/core/formulas/*.toml`, joins backslash continuations, and fails on any `bd update "$WORK_BEAD_ID" ... --notes`. The match is on the whole flag, so `--append-notes` passes. It also fails if it finds no work-bead updates, which catches a stale pattern.
- `cmd_agent_script.go`: `bd_update notes:` now emits `--append-notes`. Expectations in `cmd_agent_script_test.go` are updated. The example yamls (lifecycle, hyperscale) keep their `notes:` key unchanged.

**Tests (fail before, pass after):**
- `TestPolecatReportFormulaParsesAndHasNoGHPRCreate` fails on 0f23e4c9 ("must write findings with 'bd update "$WORK_BEAD_ID" --notes'") and passes now.
- With the formulas reverted to main, the guard fails on exactly the 5 sites (mol-do-work x2, polecat-commit, polecat-report, prompt-synth). It passes with the fix.
- `go test ./cmd/gc` (full package), `./internal/bootstrap/...`, `./internal/formula/...` and `./test/packlint/...` pass. `go vet` is clean.

**Scope note on #6523:** that issue counts seven sites. The other two are `$GC_BEAD_ID` (the step wisp, `mol-do-work.toml:142`) and `$DRAIN_BEAD_ID` (`:193`). Both are freshly created step or drain beads with no prior notes, so they keep `--notes` on purpose. The guard covers only `$WORK_BEAD_ID`.

**Risks:** Retries are no longer idempotent: a repeated close appends its "Done:" or report text twice, which is cosmetic. The polecat report now lands after any existing notes instead of being the whole field. No gc code reads work-bead notes back. The by-ID router (`cmd/gc/cmd_bd_by_id.go:448`) serves neither flag, so routing does not change. `--append-notes` exists in bd ≥ 1.0.0, and gc's minimum is 1.0.4.

Refs #6523, #5045
